claim: Login issues a bearer token with format session_<userId>_<timestamp>_<random> via SimpleTokenGenerator.
Session route parses the token with /^session_(\d+)_/ to extract userId, sharing the login-side format as a cross-route contract.
AuthenticationService.login returns AuthenticationResult containing the authenticated user and a session token; token generation is injectable (TokenGenerator).
GET /api/auth/session returns HTTP 200 with { success: true, authenticated: false } when the Authorization header is missing, not Bearer, malformed, or the user does not exist.
Tests assert authenticated:false with HTTP 200 for non-Bearer header, invalid token format, and nonexistent user (session_999).
LoginRequestSchema (zod) requires a valid email format and a non-empty password before authentication runs.
BcryptPasswordHasher stores password hashes as '<hex salt>$<HMAC-SHA256(password, salt)>' with a per-password 16-byte random salt; verify recomputes and compares.
POST /api/auth/logout without a Bearer Authorization header returns HTTP 401 unauthorized; with one it returns success.
Login, session and logout routes each have dedicated route test suites (login/route.test.ts, session/route.test.ts, logout/route.test.ts).
Playwright config enables webServer auto-start so E2E runs boot the Next.js server themselves (MS-012 T-003, commit 3d5aef34).
Package installation is governed by a zero-trust policy configured in .npmrc (root and packages/ui), added by commit a5a85c21.
LOOP.md (loop-md:spec v2) mandates one improvement per run, npm test failure as first candidate source, verification before commit, and forbids push/deploy/secrets access.
